Sunday Morning Breakfast Club

Mobile, AL · Midtown · Road

Sunday Morning Breakfast Club is a road group ride in Mobile, AL. It rolls every Sunday at 7:00 am from Nova Espresso. About 28 miles.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 7:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Sunday Morning Breakfast Club group ride

A 28-mile Sunday loop from Midtown around Brookley and down Bayfront Road. Mobilians on Bikes is a Facebook group where locals also post Tuesday, Thursday and Saturday rides. The group's own website is down, so check Facebook for the current plan.
